body: The light from my phone flickered weakly as I approached the locked gate. The smooth cut edges made me pause, sensing danger lurking within. With each step towards the door, the fear grew stronger inside me. My heart pounded against my chest, yet I pushed through the hesitation, determined to help. I took out my keys, feeling their cool metal against my fingers. As I tried to turn them, the lock creaked slightly, but still wouldn’t budge. Panic surged, but before it could consume me entirely, I decided to stay beside them and keep them steady.
